en.title: Severe hail storm forces inspections of over two dozen American Airlines jets in Philadelphia
en.summary: A severe hailstorm in Philadelphia forced American Airlines to hold two dozen aircraft for inspection and triggered an airline-only ground stop, while poor weather across the US Northeast delayed 820 flights nationwide.
body: A severe hailstorm struck parts of Delaware County and Pennsylvania on Thursday, leaving parts of Philadelphia and Philadelphia International Airport (PHL) looking as though covered in snow. American Airlines held two dozen aircraft shortly after the storm so engineers could inspect them before they were cleared to fly, according to a report by aviation insider JonNYC on X cited by Simple Flying. To allow the assessment, the airline put in place an American Airlines-only ground stop at Philadelphia, as the aircraft had been exposed to the conditions while parked at the gate.

Hail can crack or shatter cockpit windows, dent or damage the radome that houses weather radar equipment, and damage fan blades or compressors if it enters an engine. Airlines commonly place aircraft on the ground after severe hail until engineers complete a full safety assessment before clearing them to return to service. Inbound flights were also affected: passengers on AA2412 from Tampa (TPA) reported waiting up to three hours, according to a post on Reddit cited by Simple Flying.

Poor weather across the US Northeast added to the disruption, with 820 flights delayed nationwide and 65 canceled, according to Oregon Live. Low clouds, persistent rain and wind hampered services at airports including Boston, New York JFK, Newark and Washington Dulles. Simple Flying said it reached out to American Airlines for comment on Thursday, but an airline spokesperson could not immediately be reached.

zh.title: 費城強烈冰雹來襲：美國航空20多架飛機停飛受檢、820架次航班延誤
zh.summary: 費城遭強烈冰雹襲擊，美國航空20多架飛機停飛接受檢查，費城實施僅限美國航空的地面停飛；美國東北部天候不佳，全美另有820架次航班延誤、65架次取消。
body: 費城地區週四遭強烈冰雹襲擊，費城國際機場（PHL）部分區域被冰雹覆蓋、宛如積雪。據航空消息人士JonNYC在X上的消息，美國航空在冰雹過後不久扣留20多架飛機，由工程人員檢查確認無損後才能放行。為進行檢查，美國航空在費城實施僅限該公司的地面停飛，因為這些飛機停在登機門時已暴露在冰雹之中。
冰雹可能擊裂或擊碎駕駛艙窗戶、損傷裝有氣象雷達的天線罩，也可能被吸入發動機、損傷風扇葉片或壓縮機，影響飛航安全。強烈冰雹過後，航空公司通常會讓飛機維持停飛待命，直到工程人員完成全面安全評估、確認可以恢復營運。進場航班也受影響：據Simple Flying引述Reddit貼文，坦帕起飛的AA2412班機有乘客表示等了近3小時。
美國東北部整體天候不佳也加劇混亂：據Oregon Live報導，全美共820架次航班延誤、65架次取消，低雲、持續降雨與強風影響波士頓、紐約甘迺迪、紐華克與華盛頓杜勒斯等機場的運作。Simple Flying表示週四曾聯繫美國航空尋求回應，但發言人未能立即回覆。
